survey: A stylized black cat figurine sitting on a wooden plank tabletop, in three-quarter view with its head turned toward the viewer's left. Head: round, with two pointed ears placed symmetrically on top, two large yellow eyes, and a small brown nose centered below them. That layout fits the head turn. Neck: a plain red ring collar sits in the gap between the chin and the chest and goes all the way around, with no loose ends or invented clasp. Body: a pear-shaped seated torso. Two front legs come down from the chest, and their paws rest flat on the planks. The hind haunch bulges out on the right side, and the simplified figurine shows no separate hind foot, which is acceptable. Tail: it comes out from behind the haunch at lower right and curls forward around the front, lying on the table surface. Support: the paws, the haunch base and the tail all touch the planks, and a contact shadow falls behind and to the right, so the cat is grounded. Counts: 2 ears, 2 eyes, 1 nose, 2 front paws, 1 tail, all correct.
